responsibility: Implements generic input-side access to LTO object-file sections. This file defines the canonical section-name table, installs frontend-provided hooks for fetching and freeing raw section data, transparently decompresses section payloads when needed, builds simple input blocks for IPA summaries, and manages reader-side support structures such as declaration-renaming tables and per-function lto_in_decl_state objects. It is the common section-reading layer beneath higher-level LTO deserializers, handling lifetime, mapping back to compressed storage, and reporting input-buffer overruns or range errors.
